description: This Java source file defines the UrlServletHelper class, providing utility methods for handling URL-related operations in a web application, including setting request attributes, managing path aliases, and sanitizing strings for URL safety.

classes.name: UrlServletHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for URL handling, request attribute setting, path alias checking, and string sanitization in a web application.

methods.name: setRequestAttributes
methods.description: Sets request attributes such as delegator, servlet context, and webSiteId, handling multi-tenant scenarios by selecting the appropriate delegator based on the server name.

methods.name: setViewQueryParameters
methods.description: Extracts view-related query parameters from the request URL or parameters and appends them to a URL builder, also setting corresponding request attributes.

methods.name: checkPathAlias
methods.description: Checks if the request path matches a path alias in the database, forwards to the alias target if found, or sends a 404 error if the alias points to a non-existent resource.

methods.name: invalidCharacter
methods.description: Sanitizes a string by replacing various special characters with hyphens or removing certain characters, and trims leading/trailing hyphens and duplicate hyphens.
